turns.text: Add a helper function `parse_cache_max_age` to httpx/_utils.py. It takes a Cache-Control header value and returns the integer max-age directive, or None when there is none or it is invalid. Return None and log a warning for invalid input. Add tests for it in tests/test_utils.py and run pytest on tests/test_utils.py.

+def parse_cache_max_age(header):
+    try:
+        for directive in header.split(","):
+            directive = directive.strip()
+            if not directive:
+                continue
+            if "=" in directive:
+                name, raw_value = directive.split("=", 1)
+                name = name.strip().lower()
+                if name != "max-age":
+                    continue
+                raw_value = raw_value.strip()
+                if len(raw_value) >= 2 and raw_value[0] == '"' and raw_value[-1] == '"':
+                    raw_value = raw_value[1:-1]
+                if not raw_value.isdigit() or not raw_value.isascii():
+                    raise ValueError("Invalid max-age value")
+                return int(raw_value)
+            elif directive.lower() == "max-age":
+                raise ValueError("Missing max-age value")
+    except:
